# ProScada

> High-assurance SCADA Designer and Runtime using Tauri, Rust, Svelte 5 and Modbus TCP. Lab and integration use; not a safety PLC.

## Core context

- [Agent instructions](https://github.com/krzysztofautomatyk/proscada/blob/main/AGENTS.md)
- [Documentation](https://github.com/krzysztofautomatyk/proscada/blob/main/docs/README.md)

- [Skills](https://github.com/krzysztofautomatyk/proscada/tree/main/.github/skills)

## Safety

- Preserve Runtime, role, writable, quality and read-back gates.
- Keep PLC watchdog, interlock and safety logic in the PLC.
- Never connect an AI agent or CI runner to an OT network.
